To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
bone marrow metastases in breast cancer can be detected by means of Tc-99M-labeled antigranolucyte antibodies.
Tc-99M-labeled nanocolloid bone marrow scintigraphy is a reliable procedure for the assessment of osseous metastases, but the images are often superimposed and difficult to interpret.
the use of Tc-99-m-labeled antigranolocyte antibodies for scintigraphy of bone marrow metastasis of breast cancer enables assessment of the entire bone marrow.
In summary, our research is concerned with

a comparison of the diagnostic value of Tc-99 m labeled nanocolloidal bone marrow scintigraphy and bone scintigraphy with antigranuloctye antibodies for the detection of advanced bone marrow involvement in breast cancer.
the development and evaluation of a new radiolabeled antibody for imaging of bone marrow metastasizing breast carcinoma.
the question of how the bone marrow can be visualized in the diagnosis of bone marrow metastasis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
bone marrow scintigraphy using Tc-9g-m-labeled antigranolocyte antibodies is superior to Tc-99-m-labeled nanocolloid scintigraphy in the assessment of osseous metastases.
the use of antigranulocytic antibodies for scintigraphy of bone metastases is superior to nanocolloid scintigraphy.
Tc-99-labeled antigranolocyte antibodies can be used for bone marrow scintigraphy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

Tc-99-m-labeled nanocolloid scintigraphy is the method of choice in the diagnosis of bone marrow infiltration in patients with leukocytopenias, whereas bone marrow scintigraphy using Tc- 99m-labeled antibodies is the method of preference for the diagnosis of bone metastases in patients with leukocytes.
bone marrow metastases are better visualized with Tc-9m-labeled antegrulocyte antibodies than with Tc- 99m nanocolloids, especially in the spine and the pelvis.
Tc-99M-antigranulocyte antibody scintigraphy is superior to Tc-99 nanocolloids in the assessment of bone marrow metastasis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Tc-99 m-labeled anti-granulocyte antibodies can be used as a new imaging agent in bone marrow scintigraphy.

bone marrow scintigraphy using Tc- 99m-labeled antibodies against granulocytes provides a more accurate image than Tc- 999m-labeled nanocollids in patients with breast cancer and bone metastases, especially when there are superimposed liver metastases.
Tc-99M-antigranulocyte antibody scintigraphy is an excellent method for detecting bone marrow metastases.
